# gadget

**gadget** is a fast, cross-platform command-line multitool for inspecting and
transforming structured data. It reads JSON, YAML, and TOML, applies a small
query language, and writes any of those formats back out with stable key
ordering and colorized diffs.

## Highlights

- Zero-config format detection with an explicit `--from`/`--to` override.
- Streaming mode for inputs larger than memory.
- A tiny, well-documented query grammar — no embedded scripting runtime.

## Install

Pull a pinned version with the OCX CLI, then run it:

```sh
ocx pull acme/gadget@1.4.0
ocx run acme/gadget -- --from json --to yaml < input.json
```

## Example

```json
{ "name": "gadget", "platforms": ["linux", "darwin", "windows"] }
```

See the [project docs](https://example.com/gadget) for the full query grammar.
